title: RoutesExplanation
description: Wire shape of `explanation` for `bregctl explain routes`. `routes` mixes two record shapes with no shared field beyond the injected `type` discriminator: an entity-route half, which is a passthrough of the compiled route table (CompiledRoute) with `type` injected after serialization, and an action-route half, which bregctl reconstructs field by field. Only the injected `type` and the action half are pinned in full; the entity half's other fields are outside this contract version.

DerivedId.description: An identifier the compiler derives from local identifiers: two or more local identifiers joined by `.`. It is never authored.

oneOf.description: Entity route. Passthrough of the compiled route table plus the injected `type`; fields beyond `type` follow CompiledRoute and are outside this contract version.
oneOf.x-registry-passthrough: bregctl writes each entity route as the engine holds it plus the injected type; only type is pinned, and its other members follow CompiledRoute and are outside this contract version.

oneOf.description: Action route. Reconstructed field by field by bregctl.
